verdict.rationale: Core crawl capability is explicitly documented and central to Firecrawl's value prop: "Crawl an entire website and get content from all pages" plus URL discovery, async batch scraping, and high site-coverage reliability claims. This is corroborated across GitHub README and docs, though independent hands-on validation specifically of full-site crawl completeness is thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmark confirming completeness of full-site crawls at scale.
